scope: Static AArch64 disassembly only; no runtime playback, native pixels, ordinary Notes replay or Android claim.

observations.observation: Copies third and fourth call arguments into w22 and w24 respectively.
Calls native source getters for points, pressure, timestamps and point count.
Selects MotionEvent action 0 when index w24 is zero, 1 when nonzero and equal to point_count-1, otherwise 2.
Stores a MotionEvent pointer, applies selected action and increments receiver member at byte offset 528.
Branches between MotionEvent AddBatch and TouchStrokeDrawing OnTouch based on sample index and receiver state.

limitations: PaintingCompat replay belongs to the painting subsystem; equivalence to normal Samsung Notes replay is not established.

The existing Marker harness invokes completed ObjectDrawing saved redraw; it does not construct or exercise PaintingCompatReplay lifecycle, its native PageDoc/bitmap manager, TouchStrokeDrawing state, timer scheduling or framebuffer presentation.
Finished truncated strokes are not replay-frame controls. Source inspection does not provide native runtime or SVG/PDF comparison.
